messages:
maya: Quick sync request — can we schedule a 30m inference perf review next week? Need to walk through the T4 q8 latency bump, proposed quant rollout, and a short canary plan. Prefer Tue 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 15:00-15:30 PT. Agenda bullets below. Ping @sam @li @dana for data/infra.

sam: Tue works for me. I can bring the metric tables and the run artifacts.

li: Wed is better for me. If we do Tue, can we move to 10:30? I have an all-hands at 10:00.

dana: I can do either; prefer Wed. Also need to validate perf infra — pinging @perf-bot for latest run.

perf-bot: Benchmark run 2026-06-12-17 completed. Summary: T4-q8 median latency +12% vs baseline. Artifacts: https://redwood.perf/runs/20260612-17

maya: Thanks. If Wed is the common option, let's pick Wed 15:00 PT. Agenda: 1) data walk 2) repro attempts 3) kernel/quant notes 4) canary/rollback plan 5) decisions & action items.

ryan: Add one ask: include the test prompts that showed regressions. @sam can you attach those?

sam: sure — will upload a small csv and a trimmed gcs tar. Command to pull run: ```benchctl export --run 20260612-17 --out ./artifacts && gsutil cp ./artifacts gs://redwood-perf/20260612-17/```

li: Also, let's include latency distributions by sequence length. I have a quick script: ```python plot_latency.py --input run.csv --bucket gs://redwood-perf/plots``` Happy to paste in PR if helpful.

maya: Great. Who will chair? I can run the RFC review portion if @dana can speak to infra risk and @li to model ops.

dana: I'll cover infra and canary steps. Also request a 10-minute pre-meet async doc: short checklist to validate canary. I'll draft that.

maya: Perfect. I'll create a calendar invite for Wed 15:00 PT, 30m, with link to docs and perf run. If you can't make it, add preferred times & I'll try to reschedule.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll attach artifacts before EOD Mon.

perf-bot: Dashboard snapshot saved: https://dash.redwood.com/snap/20260612-17

ryan: If we decide to roll quant, please include rollback metric and a simple smoke test: top-1 latency + error-rate.

maya: Noted. Draft agenda doc: https://docs.redwood.com/infer/perf/meetings/postmortem-20260612 (will fill.)

li: Also note: legacy kernel fallback increases token latency on gen-heavy prompts. Might be related.

dana: I'll check node placement & noise from co-tenancy. If any red flags, we'll block rollout.

sam: Uploading artifacts now — link: gs://redwood-perf/20260612-17/artifacts.tar.gz

maya: Thanks all. Last Q: prefer 30m or 45m? I've been assuming 30m but we can extend.

ryan: Vote: 45m. Prefer time to triage and assign owners.

li: 30m is fine if we keep to strict agenda. 45m if we want to run a short repro live.

dana: 45m from infra side.

maya: Alright moving to 45m. Invite will be Wed 15:00–15:45 PT. I'll include prep checklist and links. cc @deploy-bot to create canary checklist issue.

deploy-bot: Created issue INF-4526 'Canary checklist for q8 quant rollout' — https://issues.redwood.com/INF-4526

maya: Thanks — thread closed unless more prep notes. See calendar.
